q: What goes into the CBAM figure for aluminium from the Sumgait smelter?
title: Sumgait aluminium: the CBAM figure
short: Only direct emissions count for aluminium: CO2 from anodes consumed in the pots, perfluorocarbons from anode effects, and fuel for casting and anode baking. Electricity is reported but not charged. Alumina refined at Ganja is not a CBAM precursor.
audience: The Azerbaijani aluminium smelter, traders and EU importers of primary aluminium

ul: Anode carbon consumed per tonne of metal.
Perfluorocarbons from anode effects, as CO2 equivalent.
Gas for casting, holding furnaces and anode baking.

p: Alumina is not listed in CBAM, so its refining emissions stay out of the CBAM figure. EU buyers asking for a full footprint will still want them.
Smelting uses a lot of power from a gas heavy grid. Report kWh per tonne and the factor, even though it is not charged.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.

sources.label: 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
